test_TestExitCodeAndOutput: test the TestExitCodeAndOutput function that verifies a command's exit code and output for uninitialized Google Test warnings
test_GTestUninitializedTest: test the GTestUninitializedTest class that runs the googletest-uninitialized-test executable and checks for proper warnings
test_AssertEq: test the AssertEq function that compares expected and actual values and raises AssertionError on mismatch
test_Assert: test the Assert function that raises AssertionError when a condition evaluates to false
test_gtest_test_utils_Subprocess: test the gtest_test_utils.Subprocess class used to run and inspect the output of the googletest-uninitialized-test executable
